2608.25655.title: Reconstructing the Right Episode: Evaluating Interleaved Conversational Memory Beyond Long Context
2608.25655.paper_summary: Conversations with chat assistants increasingly span many topics in a single long-running thread, challenging memory systems. Existing long-context and memory benchmarks often expose session or topic boundaries, or probe direct personal-memory questions. These settings understate a harder assistant-memory regime: a flat mixed-topic thread where the system must infer which earlier episode makes a later task decision valid. We introduce SCALE-QA, a constraint-grounded task QA benchmark for flat unsegmented threads targeting episode integrity failure. The dataset contains 3,000 audited questions across 10 domains, uses deterministic four-way multiple-choice grading, and includes a deterministic runtime builder; experiments use all 3,000 questions through 128k and a stratified 400-question diagnostic at 1M. SCALE-QA questions are ordinary task-oriented requests whose correct answer depends on causally related evidence introduced earlier in the conversation. We also propose Temporal-Semantic Interleaved Memory Reconstruction (TSIM), which segments the turn stream into coherent episodes and indexes them through a hierarchical multi-view memory stack with deterministic episode-level summary and cluster-routing views. Experiments show that SCALE-QA challenges strong RAG baselines and long-context LLMs alike; across three open-source and proprietary LLM backends, TSIM achieves the highest accuracy in every backend setting, gaining 5.6-17.6 accuracy points over the strongest corresponding baseline.
2608.25655.paper_summary_zh: 與聊天助手的對話越來越多地涵蓋許多主題，並且在一個長期的線程中進行，這對記憶系統提出了挑戰。現有的長上下文和記憶基準通常會暴露會話或主題邊界，或探測直接的個人記憶問題。這些設定低估了一個更困難的助手記憶體制：一個平坦的混合主題線程，其中系統必須推斷哪個早期事件使得後續任務決策有效。我們介紹了SCALE-QA，一個基於約束的任務QA基準，針對平坦的未分段線程，以解決事件完整性失敗。該數據集包含3,000個經審核的問題，涵蓋10個領域，使用確定性的四選一多項選擇評分，並包括一個確定性的運行時生成器；實驗使用所有3,000個問題進行128k的測試和在1M時的分層400問題診斷。SCALE-QA問題是普通的任務導向請求，其正確答案依賴於在對話中早期引入的因果相關證據。我們還提出了時間-語義交錯記憶重建（TSIM），它將回合流分段為連貫的事件，並通過一個層次多視圖記憶堆棧進行索引，具有確定性的事件級摘要和集群路由視圖。實驗顯示，SCALE-QA同時對強大的RAG基準和長上下文LLM提出挑戰；在三個開源和專有的LLM後端中，TSIM在每個後端設置中都達到了最高的準確性，較最強的相應基準提高了5.6-17.6個準確率點。
